name: Harm
description: Level 6 Necromancy (Doctor) Casting Time: Action Range: 60 feet Components: V, S Duration: Instantaneous You unleash virulent magic on a creature you can see within range. The target makes a Resolve saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 14d6 Necrotic damage, and its Health maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage it took. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage only. This spell can't reduce a target's Health maximum below 1.
